every joined reward has a positive exact total daily rate and an active dated positive configuration
Gamma and current-rewards minimum-size and maximum-spread terms agree
the fee schedule explicitly charges takers only

distinctness.material_new_exact_source: The current official Polymarket Python SDK exposes unsigned public GET /rewards/markets/current rows with exact condition_id, dated rewards_config, minimum size, maximum spread, and total daily rate; the terminal prior attempt used Gamma clobRewards, which was absent.
distinctness.no_failed_source_reuse: Gamma supplies exact market identity and execution parameters only; reward funding comes exclusively from the distinct current-rewards list.
distinctness.raw_first: Every request intent, raw response, and response hash is atomically journaled before parsing or identity validation.

economics.both_fill_identity: Equal quantities of Up and Down shares in one binary condition merge or settle to one pUSD per pair.
economics.market_direction_dependency: Both-fill payoff is direction independent; every one-sided fill is directional orphan exposure and must be stress charged.
economics.orphan_loss_bound: quantity times max(Up bid, Down bid)
economics.reward_duration_rule: Multiply the exact conditional daily reward equivalent by 300000 divided by 86400000.
economics.reward_share_rule: Public books cannot identify maker ownership, queue persistence, competition, random sampling, or final epoch normalization, so every reward-share calculation is conditional and the proved payout floor remains zero.
economics.stress_promotion_rule: Only the 100-times competition-stressed full-market conditional reward may advance this public screen.

requests: one Gamma GET for the seven exact frozen slugs
up to twelve unsigned sponsored=true current-rewards GET pages ending only at LTE=
one CLOB batch-books POST for the fourteen exact token IDs only after the complete one-to-one reward join passes

terminal_prohibitions: No market asset or epoch may be substituted.
A nonterminal cursor at the twelfth retained page is incomplete and rejects the screen.
No displayed program cap or daily allocation is a guaranteed user payout.
No stale or asynchronous book may establish a candidate.
No hypothetical score may be called realized profit.
No account, order, cancellation, fill, reward, merge, redemption, or trade is authorized.
